correctness.rationale: For every m≥2 the ordered directed Hom face poset consists of compatible nonempty triples (A,B,C) with A→B→C→A. Projection to A lands in the complex N of subsets lying in an m-vertex cyclic interval; the unique enclosing minimal clockwise arc [s,t] determines exact common permitted B=[t+1,s+m] and C=[t-m,s-1] modulo 2m+1. The upper fiber contracts via (A,B,C)≥(S,B,C)≤(S,B∪{s+m},C)≥(S,{s+m},C)≤(S,{s+m},W), all terms valid because b*=s+m points to every allowed C. Quillen A dual gives |Hom|≃N. The length-m open arcs (i-m+1/2,i+1/2) form a good cover of the length-(2m+1) circle; their nonempty intersections are connected arcs containing integer points, with nerve N. Thus Hom≃S1 for all m≥2; m=1 has three points and is correctly excluded. Inspected complete verify_fibers.py and verify_chains.py; bounded m tests check identities only, not proof of the infinite family.
